selector.rationale: The patient's right-sided hemiplegia, incomplete closure of the right eye, and imaging studies showing hemorrhage in the left thalamus-radiation crown region and in the lateral ventricle support the diagnosis of Stroke, which is further confirmed by the thinner corticobulbar tract on the left side before entering the brainstem.
